title: Fixed-degree stabilization of the two direct-image expressions
statement: Let k be a finite or algebraically closed field, ell a prime invertible in k, A a finite commutative ring killed by ell^r for some natural r, X and Y finite-type k-schemes, and g:X→Y a finite-type morphism (not necessarily a k-morphism). let S(K)=nu_Y^* Rg_et,* K and T(K)=Rg_proet,* nu_X^* K, using the derived functors and inverse images of [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] and [sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison]. For each etale complex K and each integer m, there is an integer N such that the canonical truncation map t:K→tau_{≥N}K induces isomorphisms H^m(S(t)) and H^m(T(t)) of pro-etale A-module sheaves. This asserts stabilization of the two functors separately and does not assert invertibility of the unbounded comparison mate.

source.place: Source and Target paragraphs; opening basis-detection argument

proof.text: Put d=2 dim(X)+1, assigning empty dimension zero. For every fixed-ring module sheaf M, finiteness of A makes the underlying abelian sheaf torsion. Apply classicalUniformBounds (3) and transport zero homology from D+ to R^q g_et,* by the single-object homology isomorphism. The canonical module/abelian comparison and faithful coefficient forgetting give R^q g_et,* M=0 for q>d.

source.place: Source paragraph: the module higher-direct-image bound

proof.text: Apply the existing proved isLE_rightDerivedFunctor_obj_of_dimension to the additive left exact etale direct image and the preceding uniform bound on its ordinary higher derived functors. It directly concerns the specified total rightDerivedFunctor. Thus E in D^{≤t} has Rg_et,*E in D^{≤t+d}; exact comparison preserves this bound.

Put G=nu_X^*, F=Rg_proet,*, and E=Rg_et,*. Exact inverse image commutes with standard lower truncations and preserves upper bounds. For K in D^{<=b}, each tau_{>=-n}K remains in D^{<=b}. The preceding etale bound puts nu_Y^*E(tau_{>=-n}K) in D^{<=b+d}. The bounded-below canonical comparison identifies this object with F(tau_{>=-n}(G(K))). Pro-etale fixed-ring module sheaves have exact countable products, as realized by the existing source instance Scheme.ProEt.countableAB4Star. Derived direct image is right adjoint to exact derived inverse image and hence preserves countable products. Apply the existing generic left-completeness bound to obtain F(G(K)) in D^{<=b+d+1}. This uses the bounded-below mate only and is independent of the unbounded comparison being proved.

source.place: Derived right adjoints preserve products and Postnikov limits; uniform truncation-bound consequence

proof.text: Fix m and choose N=m-d-2. In the standard truncation triangle E→K→tau_{≥N}K, E lies in D^{≤N-1}. Apply the two triangulated functors. Their first terms lie respectively in D^{≤N-1+d} and D^{≤N+d}. Both bounds are strictly below m and m+1. Each long exact sequence therefore makes its second map monic and epic in degree m. These are exactly the two displayed truncation maps. No sectionwise estimate on Y is needed for the source.

lean.statement:
theorem unboundedDirectImage_truncation_stability
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (hbase : Finite k ∨ IsAlgClosed k)
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (_hℓ : IsUnit (algebraMap ℤ k (ℓ : ℤ)))
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (_hA : ∃ n : ℕ, (ℓ : A) ^ n = 0)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (g : X ⟶ Y)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) (m : ℤ) :
    ∃ N : ℤ,
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) m).map
        ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).rightDerivedFunctor.map
            ((CategoryTheory.Triangulated.TStructure.truncGEπ
              DerivedCategory.TStructure.t N).app K)))) ∧
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) m).map
        ((ProEtale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).rightDerivedFunctor.map
          ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).mapDerivedCategory.map
            ((CategoryTheory.Triangulated.TStructure.truncGEπ
              DerivedCategory.TStructure.t N).app K))))
